checks.detail: The initial pose must complete a scene update before zero idle callbacks can pass. This is not a GPU-output assertion.
checks.name: initial-scene-updated

checks.detail: Scene/render callbacks and movement clock during static pose; not GPU submissions.
checks.name: static-scene-stops

checks.detail: Requires visible app and system motion policy permitting animation.
checks.name: reaction-runs-and-finishes

checks.detail: A finite reaction must return to an idle scene without an update loop.
checks.name: finished-scene-stops

checks.detail: A finite desktop movement changes position and releases its display link.
checks.name: movement-runs-and-finishes

checks.detail: Pause must interrupt a rendering reaction and window movement, stop their callbacks, and reject new animation.
checks.name: pause-stops-work

checks.detail: Clearing pause while hidden must not restart the renderer.
checks.name: hidden-stops-work

checks.detail: Checks NSWindow configuration only; an external mouse click is still required.
checks.name: whole-window-click-through-configured

checks.detail: Checks window focus eligibility; manual typing in another app is still required.
checks.name: pet-cannot-become-key

limitations: Short smoke measurements, not energy/battery benchmarks or an eight-hour soak.
Scene updates are not actual GPU submissions; use Instruments for renderer and WindowServer costs.
Motion eligibility and app activity are sampled at phase boundaries; temporary changes between samples may be missed.
Physical mouse routing, focus during another app's typing, full-screen, Spaces, Stage Manager and multiple displays require separate validation.
Procedural character does not predict the footprint of production sprite atlases.
